answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 30253 Country: India Title: I am studying C.A. course by past 15 years I am in final year. I appear many time in final exam but did not get the success. Now I want kindly make the istikhara for me as I continue the C.A. or close. If yes what amal I will do to get the success? Question: RESPECTED HAZRAT ASSALAM ALEKUMM I AM STUDYING C.A. COURSE BY PAST 15 YEARS I AM IN FINAL YEAR I APPEAR MANY TIME IN FINAL EXAM BUT DID NOT GET THE SUCCESS NOW I WANT KINDLY MAKE THE ISTIKHARA FOR ME AS I CONTINUE THE C.A. OR CLOSE. IF YES WHAT AMAL I WILL DO TO GET THE SUCCESS. Answer ID: 30253 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 467/293/D=1432) You should recite the following dua after each salah: رب زدنى علماً رب انفعنى بما علمتنى و علمنى ما ينفعنى. You should do istikhara to know whether you should continue your present education or not. The method of istikhara is written in Bahishti Zewar. Do istikhara as per the instruction given there. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
